ERROR: deslag detected a broken repository layout!

AGENTS.md has 12 problems in its "Repository layout" section.

The "Repository layout" section is where an agent new to this repo learns its way around, so it must be short and true. Under the heading, put one code block listing between 1 and 5 of the files and directories that matter most, with paths relative to the directory AGENTS.md is in, like this:

## Repository layout

```
repo/
  Makefile   <- every build, test and check
  src/       <- the source
  docs/      <- the design docs
```

The first line naming the root is optional. Every path starts in one column, every `<-` sits in one column, every entry has a description, and every entry is one line, no wider than 80 characters; a description does not continue on the next line. Paths must exist, and one ending in `/` must be a directory.

Do not change the limits or the heading to get past this check. Only a human can tell you to do that, and I am a linter, not a human.

  line 11: the path starts in column 4; the first entry's starts in column 3

  line 13: the line is 110 characters wide; shorten it to 80 or fewer
  line 14: gone.rs does not exist
  line 15: Makefile/ ends in / but is not a directory
  line 16: /etc/hosts must be relative, not absolute
  line 17: the text before `<-` must be one path
  line 18: README.md has no description after `<-`
